request.style: English, Male baritone solo with backing choir, organ, harp, strings, brass, solemn and majestic, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Abimelech came with Pikol
Said God is with you in all
Swear to me by the Lord
Do not deal falsely at all

[Chorus]
Seven ewe lambs set apart
Witness to the well you dug
Beersheba the oath was sworn
The covenant made by trust

[Verse]
You took my well by force
I did not know who did it
Now I see your anger rise
I have heard nothing of it

[Chorus]
Seven ewe lambs set apart
Witness to the well you dug
Beersheba the oath was sworn
The covenant made by trust

[Verse]
Sheep and cattle were given
The two made a covenant
Pikol left to his land
Abraham stayed in the dust

[Bridge]
He planted a tamarisk tree
Called on the name of the Lord
The Everlasting God heard
His prayer in the desert

[Outro]
Seven ewe lambs as witness
The well dug in the sand
The name of the Lord remembered
In the land of the Philistines
